CanEnter.sql:
WITH t_0_CanEnter_MultBodyAggAux AS (SELECT * FROM (
  
    SELECT
      Member.character AS character,
      FactionAccess.location AS location
    FROM
      Member, FactionAccess
    WHERE
      (FactionAccess.faction = Member.faction)
   UNION ALL
  
    SELECT
      Sponsor.character AS character,
      Sponsor.location AS location
    FROM
      Sponsor
  
) AS UNUSED_TABLE_NAME  )
SELECT
  CanEnter_MultBodyAggAux.character AS character,
  CanEnter_MultBodyAggAux.location AS location
FROM
  t_0_CanEnter_MultBodyAggAux AS CanEnter_MultBodyAggAux
GROUP BY CanEnter_MultBodyAggAux.character, CanEnter_MultBodyAggAux.location

CanInvestigate.sql:
SELECT
  CanEnter.character AS character
FROM
  CanEnter, Knows
WHERE
  (CanEnter.location = 'archive') AND
  (Knows.character = CanEnter.character) AND
  (Knows.secret = 'forged_letter')
GROUP BY CanEnter.character

CanClaimReward.sql:
SELECT
  CanInvestigate.character AS character,
  'investigation' AS reward
FROM
  CanInvestigate
WHERE
  ((SELECT
    MIN(MagicalEntangle(1, x_5.value)) AS logica_value
  FROM
    RewardClaimed, JSON_EACH(JSON_ARRAY(0)) as x_5
  WHERE
    (RewardClaimed.character = CanInvestigate.character) AND
    (RewardClaimed.reward = 'investigation')) IS NULL)
GROUP BY CanInvestigate.character, ('investigation' || '')
